description: Recommends a skip size for a job from its type, waste type and scale, using the same rules as the Rent-a-Skip skip size calculator. Returns capacity, weight guidance, the national indicative price range and the calculator link.

job_type.description: The kind of job. One of: "home-garage-clearance" (Home or garage clearance: Decluttering, furniture, general household waste); "bathroom-refit" (Bathroom refit: Suite, tiles, a little plasterboard); "kitchen-refit" (Kitchen refit: Cabinets, worktops, flooring, appliances); "garden-clearance" (Garden clearance: Greenery, turf, branches, landscaping waste); "general-renovation" (General renovation: Multiple rooms or a whole-house refresh); "construction-trade" (Construction or trade: Building sites, extensions, partition walls).

placement.description: Optional. Where the skip will sit; drives permit guidance, never the size. One of: "driveway" (Driveway or private land: No council permit needed); "road" (Road, pavement or verge: Needs a council permit).

scale.description: Job scale from 1 to 5: 1 = Small, a car boot or two; 2 = Modest, a small van load; 3 = Average, about one full room; 4 = Large, several rooms; 5 = Very large, a whole property.

waste_type.description: The waste type. One of: "general" (General or light: Mixed household, wood, furniture, garden waste); "heavy" (Heavy: Soil, rubble, brick, concrete).

name: recommend_skip_size
title: Recommend a skip size
